Perfect! All 78 tests pass ✓

**Added tier-based default discounts:**
- Exported `TIER_DISCOUNTS` from src/customers.js: gold 5%, silver 2.5%, standard 0%
- Updated `createInvoice()` to apply tier discount when line has no explicit `discountPercent`
- Explicit `discountPercent` (even 0) always overrides tier discount

**Tests cover:**
- Gold/silver/standard tier defaults applied correctly
- Explicit discounts override tier discounts
- Mixed discounts on multiple lines
- Zero-discount override still works
